name: ambient-project-layer
description: Quietly captures meaningful project events from Codex work and syncs them to Plane; distributed as platform-specific Node 22.22.1 packages.

interface.shortDescription: Quiet project capture and Plane synchronization
interface.longDescription: Capture meaningful Codex work in a local project view and synchronize it to Plane. The formal plugin is distributed as platform-specific packages for macOS arm64, macOS x64, Linux x64, Linux arm64, and Windows x64; each package carries Node 22.22.1 and reports a direct compatibility error when installed on another OS or architecture.
defaultPrompt: Maintain a lightweight project view from meaningful work.
